findings.title: Size cap that may preclude protected units or conversions
findings.excerpt: area of an ADU shall not be less than 150 square feet. (B) The gross floor area of an attached or detached ADU shall not exceed 1,200 square feet. (C) An ADU constructed within an existing or proposed single dwelling unit structure shall not have a maximum gross
findings.state_law: Gov. Code § 66321(b)(2): local maximums must allow at least 850 sq ft (1,000 sq ft for 2+ bedrooms) of interior livable space; § 66323(a)(1): conversions of existing space are not subject to size limits at all.
